ideas.title: Uncovering Daycare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope and extent of daycare fraud in Minnesota, including the $4M daycare with no kids and a misspelled sign.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and track the flow of funds to identify potential wrongdoing.
questions: How widespread is daycare fraud in Minnesota?
What steps are being taken to prevent and investigate fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on a critical issue affecting vulnerable populations. By following the money and tracking the flow of funds, we may be able to identify patterns and connections that can inform future investigations.
